Actual automatic worker admits once when current live GUI idle OR its saved normal-time flag is true; daemon with no GUI activity is normal time. A flag edit does not interrupt a pass already admitted, matching actual Qt [8,8] groups; shutdown stops before the next group. The real owned worker runs off UI, retains queue/import/current-membership/shared-media safety, and retires/wakes on accepted exit, rebind and last-owner drop. Physical captured waits remain outside the writer and final-pair waits remain intact. Hidden/retired Options cannot stage/save, declined exit preserves live work, successor owners consume the remaining real queue. Conditional finite-control FirstPass requires hosted validation; broader maintenance parents remain Partial. text_reconciliation.text: Actual Qt seconds/milliseconds fields default to 600 ms, clamp minimum 20 ms, and have 59/999 field maxima. Cancel retains raw imported milliseconds; unchanged Apply accepts displayed fields once without overwriting a concurrent policy, and explicit edits preserve their actual float-sum conversion (1 s 29 ms saves 1029 ms and reopens at 1 s 28 ms). Native-wins retained ClientOptions load, future import, field-scoped save and hidden/retired controls reach the real maintenance consumer. Each pass snapshots its saved delay; each admitted file/thumbnail pair commits its durable queue clear then waits outside the writer, including the final pair and a missing original. Successors recheck current queue/membership/shared-media/import claims. Restored local media only clears an inconsistent queue and does not perform or wait for a physical pair; actual reference re-add clears those queues before the loop. Owned worker shutdown wakes bounded waits, retires further admissions and joins on normal shutdown. Failed pairs remain queued and receive no successful-pair wait; earlier pairs stay committed. Conditional finite-control FirstPass requires hosted validation; broader maintenance parents remain Partial.
